message:
2 helper(s) imported from a relative module under a name no vocabulary can match:
      card.spec.ts:2 — `colourOf`, imported from `./support`: re-exported under another name
      tint.spec.ts:3 — `paintOf`, imported from `./support/paint`: re-exported under another name
    Every
why: Two races read through `styleOf` under names a module of the support tree gives it: `colourOf`, which the index re-exports from `./css`, and `paintOf`, which `support/paint.ts` exports from its own import. The specs import each by the name it is exported under, so no alias stands in the import, and neither name is one any definition carries: a re-export under another name is an alias one module further on.
